reviews.author: Steve Marks
reviews.text: This is who you want to hire for your projects. Kevin was incredibly accommodating. He not only showed up when he said he would to provide an estimate, but he then went out of his way to schedule our landscaping project so that it would work with our tight time frame. Besides his dependability, he is incredibly hard working. He moved 4 cubic yards of soil for us in about 4 hours. He carefully and thoughtfully spread it around our new bushes, and cleaned up afterwards. We will definitely be using him on future projects and recommending him to our friends and neighbors.

reviews.author: Cameron Whitehurst
reviews.text: I discovered Ocean View Landscaping this year and I am glad that I did! I've only had interaction with them via email, but every interaction has been prompt and very customer service oriented. They have been an amazing asset to our STR that we manage in Ocean View! I called them in the middle of the cutting season needing them to set up a new stop within a week and they were able to accommodate! As our management grows, I hope to be able to push them all the work!

reviews.author: Hillary Boyce
reviews.text: They have been servicing my yard for the last two years, but most recently they help me with a major cleanup and rebuild after a drunk driver, destroyed our planter boxes, fence, house, and everything and they were part of that cleanup. Definitely recommend. Reliable.

reviews.author: Deborah Taylor
reviews.text: I am very pleased with the service that Kevin and Ocean View Landscaping provide. My yard always looks great when he is finished. Kevin is very detail oriented and is always here on my scheduled day.

reviews.author: Mike Vecerkauskas
reviews.text: Just started with Kevin and Oceanview Landscaping. Great job, profession and detailed with our yard. Great prices and recommendations on Lawncare as well.

reviews.author: Cindy Avila
reviews.text: SO professional, true to their word, and just good honest people. You definitely want Kevin and his business part of your team. They do an incredible job...we are so impressed with the consultation, mow, edging, quick response time, flexibility, and solid prices. Best landscaping company in Norfolk.

reviews.author: KornSyrup
reviews.text: Very professional work! Paris was very thorough and effecient, and I've had no concerns since. Spotless!

reviews.author: Danika Rosales
reviews.text: I called to get an estimate and they ended up doing the service the same day! I just moved in and wanted the yard cleaned up and it looked amazing. I would’ve taken before and after pictures but I never expected such speedy service! The man who showed up was very polite and hardworking. He explained the pricing and even offered a bi weekly service with contact information for when I decided to move forward. I’d definitely recommend them if you’re looking for yard cleanup.

reviews.author: Mary McClintock
reviews.text: Kevin and his team did fantastic work installing pavers in our backyard. The finished product looks amazing. Very timely and super cleanup once the job was finished. Highly recommend Oceanview Landscaping. Mary McClintock

reviews.author: CAR
reviews.text: Kevin and his entire team do a fantastic job, mulching, trimming hedges, tidying garden beds, clearing leaves and brush, etc., for a very reasonable price. Moreover, Kevin is the consummate professional. He is incredibly responsive and reliable, and he regularly checks in to see that you’re happy with the work. I’ve hired Kevin and Ocean View Landscaping to help us out for the last two years, and I plan to continue doing so in coming years. You should too.

reviews.author: Tyler Love
reviews.text: Kevin at Ocean View Landscaping was timely, did a great job with our plants/yard, and his services were extremely reasonably priced! I would highly recommend Ocean View Landscaping for anyone in the area!

reviews.author: Spivey Ward
reviews.text: These guys were some of the nicest gentlemen I've ever met. I really needed someone to help me take care of my lawn while my Navy husband is away. They promptly inspected my lawn and made time for me within their busy schedule to help me out when I really needed. I couldn't be more grateful! I highly recommend them for their wonderful attitude, professionalism, and kindness!

reviews.author: Emily Russell
reviews.text: Ocean View Landscaping is the best lawn care company is Norfolk. They are always responsive and keep our property in tip top shape! They provide regular scheduled mowing and also seasonal yard clean up service with tree and bush trimming. If you are in the Norfolk/ Va beach area I highly recommend them :)

reviews.author: Susan Isenhour
reviews.text: Kevin is always professional, efficient and friendly. I've been a customer since he started and have been very pleased with his services. I would and have recommended him to others.

reviews.author: sera lorenzo
reviews.text: Kevin and his crew did a great job with my yard. He responded very fast which i appreciated. The pricing was great. 10/10 would recommend him again!!

reviews.author: Jordan Halvorsen
reviews.text: Kevin is the best around. Always courteous and hard-working and does the job right! would recommend him to anybody that needs grass cutting or lawn service.

reviews.author: Marquita Lynch
reviews.text: Kevin is about his business. Professional, punctual, and made our yard look beautiful. Just like getting a haircut! He takes pride is his work and his services is highly recommended.

reviews.author: Freeman Family
reviews.text: Initial experience and expectations were superb until recently. Business is growing rapidly. Owner seems very customer-friendly but needs some guidance on how to run a small business. Issues with communication were a bit of a challenge so I had to find a new vendor. Overall, fair pricing and consistent quality if he’s not too busy.

reviews.author: Michelle Koontz
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Kevin is extremely responsive and always on time. Thank you for the incredibly fast service and always exceeding expectations.

reviews.author: Robb Overholt
reviews.text: Just started with Keven and am very pleased. He is attentive and does a great job. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Troy Blattner
reviews.text: They do an awesome job and are very cheap and affordable. They mow, weed-eat, and edge and take their time. They have been coming bi-weekly for a few months now and I have not had one thing to complain about. I highly recommend them!
